interface.longDescription: A.S.F.R.E.E is a modular, evidence-driven orchestrator for authorized AI and software forensics, evaluation, diagnosis, comparison, supervised remediation and reconstruction. M00 coordinates O01–O12; Security & Governance and Evaluation Intelligence operate as cross-cutting control planes. Historical unnumbered skill names are redirect-only compatibility paths; numbered O01–O12 are the only canonical specialist procedures. The repository package and Plugin Creator app release are separate lifecycle artifacts and require explicit synchronization and read-back. Runtime and source-bundle versions remain independent. The portable package contains skills and contracts only; it does not itself deploy scanners, runtimes, databases, API gateways or MCP servers.
